articles.title: Anthropic’s prospectus details losses, growth, and, yes, a warning that its AI could end humanity
articles.summary: In its prospectus, Anthropic just told investors it's losing tens of billions of dollars a year, but also growing like crazy, and — oh yeah — its own AI might pose an existential risk to humanity.

articles.title: Peak XV ups Surge seed investment ceiling to $5M, unveils 18-startup cohort
articles.summary: Thirteen of the 18 startups in Peak XV’s latest Surge cohort are targeting global markets, while more than half are based in India.

articles.title: OpenAI reportedly ditches model over safety concerns
articles.summary: A top executive at the AI lab told the Wall Street Journal that the model in question had displayed a poor aptitude for following orders.

articles.title: Aurora CFO says 30,000 driverless trucks by 2030 isn’t as far-fetched as it sounds
articles.summary: Self-driving truck company Aurora laid out an audacious plan for 2030. Its CFO says its targets aren't aspirational.

articles.title: Source: Inference provider Modal Labs closing in on $750M round at $15.75B valuation
articles.summary: The new financing is expected to more than triples the AI infrastructure startup's valuation from just four months ago.

articles.title: AMD will acquire Fei-Fei Li’s World Labs for $8.2 billion
articles.summary: The acquisition will see World Labs founder Fei-Fei Li join AMD as executive vice president and chief scientist.

articles.title: Shopify opens checkout to browser-based AI agents
articles.summary: Shopify is expanding WebMCP support to checkout, allowing browser-based AI agents to update order details and complete purchases with a buyer’s authorization.

articles.title: Tesla delays Roadster 2 event again due to bad weather
articles.summary: Tesla says the event "can only be held outdoors," as it's expected to show the car flying in some form using SpaceX thrusters.

articles.title: The AI boom took over Climate Week and not everyone is happy about it
articles.summary: Just like the rest of the U.S., data centers and AI are dividing climate tech founders and investors.

articles.title: Nvidia launches new platform for reining in rogue AI agents
articles.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang on Monday introduced a toolkit of software and hardware products that add independent security layers around AI agents to ensure they stay within their test environments even if they attempt to break out.

articles.title: Anthropic releases Sonnet 5.5, which it calls a significantly cheaper, faster work partner
articles.summary: Anthropic has released the newest version of its mid-range model, boasting faster response times and less token burn.

articles.title: Google is killing off Gemini’s Gems in favor of ‘skills’
articles.summary: As all-in-one AI agents like Meta's Muse and Instinct take off, Google is opting to end a feature that built task-specific agents.

articles.title: OpenAI still doesn’t seem to have a handle on all of its rogue AI activity
articles.summary: On Friday, OpenAI published a new site devoted to “misalignment reports” and the breadth of the incidents is alarming.

articles.title: Meta launches enterprise AI platform, hires MongoDB CEO to lead new initiative
articles.summary: Meta says it will focus on bringing its full technology stack, including Muse, Meta Business Agent, Muse API, Muse Code, and more to businesses and developers.

articles.title: The iPhone Duo may already have its first killer app: a virtual Walkman
articles.summary: The app imitates how Walkmans used to function: You can open up the Duo to pick your music and "insert" your cassette tape, then close the device shut to start listening.

articles.title: MAVI bets on the AI boom creating demand for a new kind of accountant
articles.summary: Accounting staffing company MAVI emerges from stealth with $4 million in funding.

articles.title: After a deepfake voice fooled her grandfather, this founder sprang into action
articles.summary: After her grandfather was scammed by a deepfake of his brother's voice, Tarini Padmanabhuni founded DetectifAI, a San Francisco startup building AI models small enough to run directly on smartphones and flag fake voices in real time, and it's now one of the companies competing in Startup Battlefield at TechCrunch Disrupt.
